role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Agfa's Sales leadership sells into sign manufacturers, commercial printers, and vehicle wrap companies globally—the same companies that are direct purchasers of Tedlar protective films. The VP of Sales would care about Tedlar as a strategic partnership opportunity because: (1) Sales teams can close higher-value printer deals by offering a complete durability solution—'Agfa printers + Tedlar overlaminate = guaranteed 15+ year outdoor performance'—addressing the #1 customer concern about outdoor graphics longevity; (2) In competitive situations against HP, Canon, Epson (competitors seen at FESPA), a validated Tedlar partnership differentiates Agfa's solution and justifies premium pricing; (3) Sales owns customer acquisition and retention metrics—co-marketing programs, joint case studies, and technical webinars with Tedlar provide lead generation tools and strengthen customer relationships; (4) With Agfa operating in 40+ countries through wholly owned sales organizations, a Tedlar partnership enables consistent global messaging about durability and premium positioning; (5) Large fleet graphics and transit customers demand long warranty periods—Tedlar's extreme durability (no yellowing, fading, cracking) enables Sales to confidently commit to extended performance guarantees that close enterprise deals.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As VP of Sales at a $2.4B enterprise equipment manufacturer, [Name] leads global sales organizations across 40+ countries selling Jeti Tauro, Anapurna Ciervo, and Onset Grizzly large-format printers to sign manufacturers, print service providers, and vehicle wrap installers. This role owns revenue targets, win rates against competitors like HP, Canon, and Epson, and customer acquisition/retention metrics. [Name] likely reports to the Chief Commercial Officer or President and manages regional sales directors, key account managers, and business development teams. Decision authority includes partnership agreements, co-marketing programs, strategic alliances, and sales enablement investments that differentiate Agfa's offerings in competitive deals.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For [Name]'s sales organization, Tedlar's most relevant use cases are: (1) Outdoor signage and architectural graphics—where Agfa's customers need solutions that withstand UV exposure, temperature extremes, and graffiti vandalism over 12-20+ year lifespans, allowing sales teams to position complete durability packages that justify premium printer pricing; (2) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics—where transit authorities and commercial fleets demand extended warranties and low maintenance costs, and Tedlar's proven resistance to fading, cracking, and graffiti enables [Name]'s team to confidently commit to performance guarantees that close large enterprise deals; (3) High-profile architectural installations—where end-client reputation risk makes material failure catastrophic, and Tedlar's 60+ year track record provides the technical credibility needed to win competitive bids against Canon, HP, and Epson in premium segments.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] owns quarterly revenue targets, printer unit sales, average selling price (ASP), and win rate metrics against major competitors. Personal pain points include: (1) Losing competitive deals on total cost of ownership arguments when competitors offer 'complete solution' positioning; (2) Customer complaints about print durability that create renewal risk and damage Agfa's brand reputation in the market; (3) Inability to differentiate in mature markets where printer specifications have commoditized; (4) Sales team requests for stronger value justification tools to defend premium pricing. Tedlar directly addresses these stakes by: enabling higher ASPs through bundled durability solutions, reducing customer churn from performance issues, providing competitive differentiation in head-to-head evaluations, and delivering quantifiable TCO advantages (fewer replacements, lower maintenance costs) that sales teams can present in ROI models. Additionally, partnership with Tedlar creates co-marketing assets, joint customer case studies, and technical validation that strengthen sales enablement and accelerate deal cycles.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Agfa showcased Anapurna Ciervo at ISA International Sign Expo 2024 and debuted three new printers at FESPA Global Print Expo with major presence alongside competitors. The company recently secured three 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards from PRINTING United Alliance, demonstrating momentum in premium product positioning. This recognition creates natural timing for [Name] to explore strategic partnerships that enhance Agfa's competitive differentiation story. Additionally, with 2025 trade show season approaching (ISA Sign Expo 2025, FESPA 2025), this is the ideal window for [Name] to evaluate co-marketing opportunities, joint customer presentations, and partnership announcements that maximize visibility at industry events where Agfa competes directly with HP, Canon, and Epson for market leadership.
